title: Dynamic pack loading without static imports
description: New packs are discovered and loaded at runtime via FactoryRegistry.get_app().
expected_behavior: FactoryRegistry discovers packs by scanning directories, loads them via importlib, and caches instances. No static imports required.

test_steps.action: create a temporary pack directory with __init__.py and get_app()

test_steps.expected: pack name returned in discovered list

test_steps.action: call FactoryRegistry.get_app with discovered pack name
test_steps.expected: app instance returned without static import

test_steps.action: call get_app again for same pack
